title: Learning with minibatch Wasserstein: asymptotic and gradient properties
tldr_zh: minibatch OT 是隐式正则化：估计与梯度无偏、集中界与维度无关，但失去距离性质、平均 plan 非最优。
tldr_en: Minibatch OT losses are unbiased with dimension-free concentration and unbiased gradients, but lose the metric property and yield non-optimal averaged plans.
key_numbers: Deviation bound M_h(sqrt(log(2/delta)/(2 floor(n/m))) + sqrt(2 log(2/delta)/k)), dimension-free, M_h = O(log m) (Theorem 1)
Marginal error of subsampled plan <= sqrt(2 log(2/delta)/k) (Theorem 2), O(k^-1/2) confirmed empirically (Fig. 6)
Color transfer on ~943k-pixel images: m=10 needs K=1e7, m=100 K=2e6, m=1000 K=6e5 (Fig. 5)
CelebA gradient flow 5000 male -> 5000 female, m=500, k=10, 750 iterations (Fig. 4)
Memory O(n) for minibatch barycentric mapping vs O(n^2) exact OT (Sec. 4.3)
